conventions.summary: arcade driving of the sedan on the campus roads (FF-C1 item 5) on the Golden Gate driving model's conventions (packages/golden-gate/data/driving.json): the same start rule, speeds, brakes, coasting, reverse, curb, traffic margins, road-end turn-around and controls; src/campus/drive/car.ts is the model
conventions.units: metres, seconds, m/s and m/s^2; angles in degrees except freightParking.heading in radians; pairs written [a, b] run from standstill (a) to topSpeed (b)
conventions.frame: the campus frame (data/campus.json): u north, v east, the roundabout centre at the origin; a heading is atan2(dv, du) (0 north, 90 east); right-hand traffic
conventions.steer: Golden Gate's car keeps within a heading offset of its lane; the campus car drives a roundabout and turns into the cross pass, so it steers a kinematic bicycle about its rear axle: the front wheel angle follows the input at steer.rateDegPerSecond toward at most steer.wheelDeg (Golden Gate's wheel angles), held so the lateral acceleration v^2 tan(wheel) / wheelbase stays within steer.lateralAccel, and returns to straight when released; reversing swings the nose the other way, as a real car does
conventions.road: the car drives the drivable area of data/campus.json (src/campus/roads.ts drivableArea): the split road to its car ends, the drop-off bays, the roundabout outside its island and kerb, and the cross-pass stubs; at its edge the footprint is held curb.clearance inside, the car bumps (keeps curb.speedKept of its speed, at most once per curb.cooldown seconds) and its heading relaxes along the edge
conventions.traffic: the car brakes for a vehicle ahead and is held clear sideways; traffic brakes for the car. Lookahead is at least traffic.range and expands to cover stopping distance at boosted speed
conventions.roadEnd: the car's roads end at the split road's car ends (roads.split.carEnd) and the cross-pass stub ends (roads.cross.stubEnd); facing one within roadEnd.promptDistance a turn-around prompt shows; the car stops roadEnd.stopDistance before it (under the arrival canopy at the split road's ends); holding the throttle against that stop, or reverse at rest within promptDistance (reverse does not engage there), for roadEnd.holdSeconds turns the car around, as does the turn-around key; turning around fades to black, moves the car to the mirror position across the road's centre line facing back along the road, at rest, and fades back
conventions.enter: Enter the fab is offered while the car's centre is inside data/campus.json interior.enterZone at no more than its maxSpeed (the south-west arrival canopy); Exit brings the car back there, at rest
conventions.controls: keyboard codes (KeyboardEvent.code); W/S accelerate or brake and reverse, A/D steer, Shift boosts forward acceleration and speed. Touch uses independent steering, Throttle, Brake / reverse and Boost controls. Brakes, traffic and road-end limits retain priority
conventions.chase: the kit's VehicleRig behind the car with Golden Gate's chase values; a pinch or the mouse wheel scales distance and height within zoom (the kit's zoom range); a one-finger or mouse drag swings the camera around the car and it returns behind it (the kit's orbit offset); the near plane is chase.near while driving
conventions.flow: traffic on the eight split-road lanes of data/campus.json (four each way, through the roundabout): Golden Gate's free-flowing model (packages/golden-gate/src/traffic/sim.ts) with its seed, class weights, palette, IDM and brake-light values; each lane's cruising speed is its lane speed, held on the fillets and the ring to sqrt(flow.lateralAccel x radius), planned ahead at flow.planDecel; vehicles enter and leave at the lane ends and fade over flow.fade metres there, which must fit inside roads.split.dissolve (the road fading into grade); mean entry headway and the per-lane cap are the tier's (data/campus.json tiers trafficHeadway, trafficPerLane) and levels of detail switch at the tier's trafficLod distances; vehicles[type].lanes are the lane indices (0 next to the centre line .. 3 outer) the type may use
conventions.lamps: vehicle lamps as Golden Gate's layout.json lights.vehicleLamps: emissive = authored emissive colour x mix(gain[0], gain[1], level); brake lamps further scaled by mix(brakeOff, 1, braking); taillights scaled so their largest channel is at most taillightPeak; lamps.day is the day preset's level
conventions.paint: the driven sedan's colour, a name from flow.palette
